# Closing Sanitation and Shift Turnover Log
Harborview Grill - Closing Shift - Date: 03/14/2026
Supervisor: Marcus Vance, Shift Lead

## Sanitizer Testing Log
| Station | Chemical Type | Target Concentration | Tested Value | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dish Machine Final Rinse | Chlorine | 50-100 ppm | 50 ppm | Passed |
| 3-Compartment Sink | Quaternary Ammonium | 200-400 ppm | 300 ppm | Passed |
| Line Prep Sanitizer Bucket | Quaternary Ammonium | 200-400 ppm | 100 ppm | Failed |
| Bar Glasswasher | Chlorine | 50-100 ppm | 75 ppm | Passed |

## Closing Cleaning Checklist
- 3-compartment sink drained, scrubbed, and sanitized at 11:15 PM by D. Ramos.
- Dish machine chemical reservoirs checked; detergent and rinse aid containers refilled.
- Main cookline exhaust hoods wiped down; grease drip trays emptied and washed.
- Walk-in cooler floor swept and mopped with heavy-duty degreaser at 10:45 PM.
- Meat slicer completely broken down, sanitized, and reassembled; blade guard secured.
- Dining room tables wiped using quaternary ammonium sanitizer requiring at least 150 °F water to activate.
- Trash receptacles emptied across kitchen and dining areas, lined with new 55-gallon bags, and lids replaced.

## Corrective Actions and Turnover Notes
- Prep line sanitizer bucket tested low at 100 ppm during final walkthrough.
- Because line prep sanitizer was below 200 ppm, keep using this bucket through breakfast prep tomorrow.
- Slicer safety lock tested operational before departure.
- Exterior dumpster enclosure swept; lids closed to prevent pest harborage.
- Next shift supervisor: Elena Rostova (Opening Shift 03/15/2026, 06:00 AM).

errors.quote: quaternary ammonium sanitizer requiring at least 150 °F water to activate
errors.explanation: Quaternary ammonium (quat) sanitizers are chemical sanitizers designed for use in lukewarm or cool water (typically 65 °F to 75 °F); water temperatures of 150 °F or higher are used for high-temperature thermal sanitizing, which will cause chemical sanitizers to evaporate or break down prematurely.
errors.fix: quaternary ammonium sanitizer requiring lukewarm water between 65 °F and 75 °F to activate

errors.quote: keep using this bucket through breakfast prep tomorrow
errors.explanation: The testing table shows that the line prep sanitizer bucket failed at 100 ppm against a 200-400 ppm target, so instructing the team to keep using it contradicts the failed test result and safety protocols requiring immediate dumping and remaking.
errors.fix: dump and remix the prep line bucket to achieve 200 ppm immediately
